blockers.summary: Public bound-key combinations can silently render no visible band; the correct type and fallback need owner judgment.
Missing or non-numeric bound values are fabricated as zero, which can misrepresent the supplied range; the correct missing-data behavior needs owner judgment.
Meaningful confidence-band fills measure 1.09:1–1.30:1 against their rendered backdrop, below 3:1.
ChartArea has no owned Storybook story, so scoped a11y and RTL audits fail before measuring it.
The canary-exported component has an empty description and no public prop or usage inventory.

notes: Limited-section weight is redistributed across Behavior, rendered Design, Testing, and Docs.
The CLI command `astryx component ChartArea --dense` was run and failed because the in-repo Lab package is not discoverable through that command.
The band contrast finding is retained, not auto-fixed, because changing opacity, stroke defaults, or representation is a public/default/visual decision.
